title: File the annual unclaimed property holder report (New York)
description: Businesses holding property that has gone unclaimed — uncashed payroll or vendor checks, customer credits and refunds, unused gift cards, deposits — must report and turn it over to the state each year, after sending the owner a due diligence notice before the deadline. The annual report and payment are due March 10 for general property. The directory page defers to the Comptroller's calendar; March 10 comes from a 2026 industry guide, so confirm it. Which state's law applies depends on the owner's last known address, or the business's state of incorporation when there is none, so a business can owe reports to several states.
